content:
maya: quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8721 showing a perf regression in the longseq canary. p95 jumped for 4k seq. bench artifacts: https://artifacts.local/8721 . looking for quick reviews + approvals to either hold or revert.

chris: thanks for the heads up. can you paste the bench numbers here?

maya: sure — dropping the key numbers and artifact link:
```
model: redwood-4k
config: microbatch=8, kv_shard=2
baseline p95: 82ms
canary p95: 126ms (+54ms, +66%)
p50: 18ms -> 22ms
mem p95: 6.2GB -> 7.9GB (+1.7GB)
throughput: 12k tok/s -> 10.1k tok/s (-15%)
artifacts: s3://rwd/bench/8721/
```

ben: that mem jump looks real. any allocation diff or stack trace pointing at kv cache or tiling?

maya: allocation diff attached in artifacts. quick read: small change in prefetch handler, snippet:
`if (prefetch_limit > 0) prefetch_chunks += 1;`
I suspect an off-by-one when tiling large sequences — increases prefetching and pushes memory/latency on longseq.

tj: canary results mirror that: tail only on longseq, short sequences look fine. sounds plausible that prefetch interacts badly with tiling/prefill paths. i'd prefer revert + smaller follow-up patch.

chris: i can approve a revert PR if we confirm revert brings perf back. maya, can you queue a revert and run a quick canary?

maya: queued revert PR and kicked off canary: https://ci.local/builds/9876 — perf-bot should post results when done.

perf-bot: Canary results for build 9876: p95 83ms (baseline 82ms), mem p95 6.3GB. No regression flagged. :white_check_mark:

ben: LGTM to revert. leaving +1.

tj: +1 as well. recommend we hold the original PR and open a follow-up that limits prefetch increments (or bounds it by tile_count).

maya: will open the follow-up with a small unit-test around tiling/prefetch. tagging @chris for merge permission on the revert. scheduling the revert canary for 02:00 UTC tomorrow.

chris: ack. i'll merge after final infra check and canary green.

maya: closing the loop — revert PR merged, final canary green. opened follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/1123 . thanks everyone! :tada:
